discovery_query: exact rank and determinant of a matrix over a finite field

PrimeFieldMatrix.description: An immutable matrix with an exact prime and explicit empty shape.
PrimeFieldMatrix.title: PrimeFieldMatrix

input_schema.description: A bounded integer matrix over an explicit prime field GF(p), as the canonical `PrimeFieldMatrix` value: `prime` must be a prime integer in [2, 2147483647], `entries` must have at most 256 rows, each row 1..256 columns, all rows the same length matching the declared `columns`, and every entry a canonical residue in [0, prime). Zero rows are permitted and carry the explicit `columns` axis.
input_schema.title: PrimeFieldMatrixRequest

output_contract.title: PrimeFieldMatrixRankResult
output_contract.source: PrimeFieldMatrixRequest, retaining the exact input matrix

scope: One bounded exact check of the actual L restriction. This operation does not construct Hankel bases, differentiate kernels, lift a tangent, or prove real existence. Those are reconstructed separately.
